Position Title:
Software Developer I 
 
 Job Group:
Professional & Scientific 
 
 Required Minimum Qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent 
 
 Job Description:
 The Center for Survey Statistics and Methodology (CSSM) in the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences at Iowa State University is seeking a Software Developer I. CSSM provides statistical research and consulting, data analysis, software development, and IT support related to grants and cooperative agreements.  CSSM works with a number of groups including the Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS), Bureau of Land Management (BLM), and other groups at Iowa State University. This position is specifically responsible for the development of software for the USDA-sponsored National Resources Inventory (NRI) survey and other CSSM clients.  This position will be involved with one or more of the following components: software development with statistical methods and algorithms; development of an estimation program with statistical sampling and imputation methods; database programming; systems programing; web application programming.

 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, mathematics, statistics, or related field
 Previous experience working in a higher education setting
 Previous knowledge or experience working with NRI
 Programming experience with machine learning and LLMs 
 Programming experience with contrastive learning methodology 
 
The Center for Survey Statistics and Methodology (CSSM) in the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences at Iowa State University provides statistical research and consulting, data analysis, software development, and IT support related to grants and cooperative agreements. CSSM works with a number of groups including the Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS), Bureau of Land Management (BLM), National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS), and within ISU, the Survey & Behavioral Research Services (SBRS).

 For more information about CSSM, please visit: https://www.cssm.iastate.edu/ 

 This a term position with an end date of 3/31/2027. The possibility for renewal is based on funding availability . 
 
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis without sponsorship. Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position.

 Application Instructions: 
To apply for this position, please click on “Apply” and complete the Employment Application. Please be prepared to enter or attach the following:
 Resume/Curriculum Vitae
 Letter of Application/Cover Letter
 
 Why Choose Iowa State University? 
Iowa State Employees enjoy comprehensive health and work-life benefits, including medical and dental, as well as:

 Generous vacation, holiday, and sick time and leave plans
 Onsite childcare (Ames, Iowa)
 Life insurance and long-term disability
 Flexible Spending Accounts
 Various voluntary benefits and discounts

 Wellbeing program
 
 If you have questions regarding this application process, please email employment@iastate.edu, or call 515-294-4800 or Toll Free: 1-877-477-7485.
